name: Frost Brute
summary: Towering corpse swollen by glacial rot. Two damage per hit and ignores light armor. The signature heavy zombie of the frozen wastes.

name: Frost Climber
summary: Skitters straight up walls and battlements — barricades and obstacles will not save you. Lunges over cover to reach archers.

name: Frost Necromancer
summary: D-rank caster. Summons fresh frost walkers each turn — kill it fast or be overrun. Always flees melee.

name: Frost Runner
summary: Sprinting corpse, unnaturally fast. Activates twice on Necromancer turns. Targets the wounded first.

name: Frost Sprite
summary: Mischievous ice elemental. Fragile but dangerous magic. Stays at range.

name: Frost Walker
summary: Shambling frost-rotted corpse. Slow, weak, and individually no threat — but they always come in numbers.

name: Frostfire Chimera
summary: C-rank boss. Dual fire/ice heads. The first real challenge in Frostbitten. Resists both fire and water.

name: Ice Wolf
summary: Common predator of the Frostwood. Hunts in packs. Weak to fire.

name: Kumiho, Nine-Tailed Trickster
summary: B-rank abomination. The nine-tailed fox-spirit, mythical entity of trickery and deception. Charms a survivor each turn — once charmed…

name: Oni Marauder
summary: C-rank demon. Crashed down from the mountain shrines wielding an iron kanabō. Each smash sends survivors flying; rage builds the longer…

name: Snow Bear
summary: Massive bear of the frozen north. Extremely tough. Don't let it reach you.

name: Yeti, the Mountain Terror
summary: B-rank abomination. The elusive cryptid of the high peaks. Ignores mundane weapons; pulls down the mountain itself to bury survivors.…

name: Abomination
summary: B-rank boss zombie. Towering mass of fused corpses — impervious to mundane weapons. Only fire, explosives, or boss-tier abilities deal…

name: Crawler
summary: Half-eaten zombie dragging itself along the ground. Hard to hit with ranged weapons — high evasion vs. arrows and bullets.

name: Fatty
summary: Bloated zombie, swollen on rot. Two damage minimum to kill — anything weaker just bounces off. When it dies, two Walkers spawn from the…

name: Necromancer
summary: C-rank caster. The most dangerous threat in any horde — opens new spawn zones each turn and floods the map with walkers. Always kill the…

name: Runner
summary: Sprinting corpse. Activates twice on Necromancer turns — covers ground frighteningly fast. Goes for the wounded first.

name: Toxic Walker
summary: Pus-bloated walker leaking acid bile. Releases a poison cloud when killed — close-range melee carries serious risk.

name: Walker
summary: Standard shambling corpse. Slow, weak, individually no threat. The horde is the threat.
